text.Agenda List:
01  Why we re-architected
02  New runtime design
03  Latency results

text.Content Title: The new runtime has three layers
text.Column Body 1:
Routes requests by model version and device class.
Adds canary and shadow traffic.
text.Column Body 2:
TensorRT and ONNX Runtime kernels built per SKU.
Cached in a content-addressed store.
text.Column Body 3:
p50/p99 latency and accuracy drift per device.
Feeds automatic rollback.

text.Metric Points:
p50: 38 ms to 24 ms
p99: 210 ms to 122 ms
No accuracy regression (Δ < 0.1 pt)
